{{Quote|This one does not look into the future. It is more fun to be surprised.|[[Saba Sebatyne]]|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''Precognition''', also known as '''danger sense''', was a universal [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by Force-sensitives with high experience in the Force.

==Description==
The ability of ''foresight'' was perhaps universal to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and was manifested in the form of [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] of future events, guiding ''premonitions'' or ''warnings'', and an inflow of prescience that helped the Jedi predict their opponent's movements.

This [[Force power/Legends|ability]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was not restricted to the Jedi, however, as the Sith also were known to perceive direction and insight from the dark side.

Battle Precognition was a variant of precognition that allowed one to sense and foretell the flows of the Force while engaged in battle.

Another variant of precognition was Blink, the name given to an unconscious ability that [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Nova Stihl]] possessed. This power, which was in reality a manifestation of his latent [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], allowed him to anticipate others' actions when engaged in a fight.

==Users==
{{Quote|Who's got the better danger sense?|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>}}
[[Skere Kaan]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] used battle precognition in space battles with [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Lord Hoth]]'s [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]] (better known as "Scout") had this power. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Meetra Surik]] were known to be gifted users of battle precognition. Surik learned this ability from [[Brianna]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] also possessed a natural ability for precognition before he even began training as a Sith. [[Nova Stihl]] possessed a nearly identical ability, which he called Blink.

[[Carnor Jax]] trained in the art. [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] former Master, [[Tyvokka/Legends|Tyvokka]] was known to have advanced Force precognition powers.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] often recognized these premonitions from the Force when they began as a "small voice," when ''instinct'' began ticking inside him, telling him to pursue a course of action: "''He had learned not to ignore that small voice''. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon]] had taught him that. If he could teach [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] one thing, it would be to ''slow down enough to hear that insistent sound, ''sometimes no more than a'' whisper,'' that said, ''follow this''."<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>

The Jedi [[Suljo Warde]] developed a unique form of precognition that allowed him to see the future actions and choices of others, but not his own. Additionally, Warde's visions were possible futures, and thus not guaranteed to be correct.<ref name="CotG">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] also enjoyed this Force gift of sensing on occasion not only premonitions, but also warnings of danger.
